title.zh: 【Coinbase 爱尔兰子公司就客户资金保障问题与爱尔兰央行和解，将支付 325 万欧元罚款】
title.en: 【Coinbase 爱尔兰子公司就客户资金保障问题与爱尔兰央行和解，将支付 325 万欧元罚款】

current_state.zh: Coinbase's Irish e-money subsidiary will pay a €3.25 million fine to the Central Bank of Ireland after settling an investigation into past client-fund safeguarding failures, including cross-entity commingling and a code error that left safeguarding accounts roughly 0.54% short on average in 2023 and the first half of 2024.
